name: s2-return
description: Short-term memory: the agent survives restarts and continues mid-conversation; a returning customer in the SAME conversation is remembered.

messages: Hi, I'm Maya Chen from Northwind Robotics. I was double-charged $49 for Acme Cloud Compute — my email is maya.chen@northwind.example.
Can you also check whether Acme Cloud Functions is having issues? Our event processing looks slow this morning.
I prefer email over phone for any follow-ups, by the way.

sessions.comment: Same conversation, continued after an app restart (see --restart-beat).
messages: Back again — any update on that duplicate charge? And remind me what we said about Functions.
